disambiguation: It is a navigation layer, not a semantic search engine or summarizer.
extras: Requires manual installation from GitHub release; in early MVP development.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Agent Context gives the agent a lightweight orientation layer first.
motivation: To provide AI agents with a lightweight orientation layer of the workspace, reducing blind reading and token waste.
problem: AI agents often lack structural knowledge of a vault, leading to inefficient reading, token waste, and difficulty locating relevant files.
summary: Generates a local, token-free, agent-readable index of the Obsidian vault structure to help AI agents navigate content without external API calls.
